opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Ohio. Motions of respondents Robert E. Blazer, David Wyant, Mark Staton, Aaron L. Plessinger, Clancy Van Gundy, Bryan Krebs, and Charles Culp for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Wisconsin v. Mitchell, ante, p. 476.
